# linearctl notification

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill-docs.py from --help; do not edit. -->

## linearctl notification list

```
List your inbox notifications, newest first. readAt is null for an unread one;
Linear has no unread filter, so filter on readAt yourself.

Fields: id, type, title, subtitle, url, createdAt, readAt, snoozedUntilAt,
actor, issue, comment

Usage:
  linearctl notification list [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl notification list --limit 20 --json

Flags:
      --cursor CURSOR   continue after CURSOR (nextCursor from the previous page)
      --fields FIELDS   return only these comma-separated FIELDS (see Fields above)
  -h, --help            help for list
      --limit N         show at most N items; 0 for all (default 50)
      --type TYPE       only notifications of TYPE as Linear names them (e.g. issueAssignedToYou)
```
